semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in surface treatment and plating chemicals and processes specifically for semiconductor back-end processing.
summary: Okuno Chemical Industries focuses on the production of surface treatment chemicals and plating equipment tailored for semiconductor back-end processing. Their offerings include copper sulfate plating additives and electroless copper plating processes that enhance adhesion and smoothness on various substrates, including glass, which is becoming increasingly important for next-generation package substrates.
capabilities: TORYZA LCN series copper sulfate plating additive for semiconductor wafers
TORYZA EL PROCESS for UBM formation for aluminum electrodes on wafers
TORYZA LCN LXD copper sulfate plating additive for hybrid Cu-CU bonding
Electroless copper plating process for glass substrates
